[EN]

### OCDSB Students!

OCDSB students (Elementary and Secondary students) compete for free! Please add the following note in the comments of your registration: "OCDSB Student, my student email is {student email here}" Please do not pay the registration fee.

### Ottawa Mini Winter Series

This competition is in a series with [Ottawa Mini Winter A 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OttawaMiniWinterA2025) (Friday Evening) and [Ottawa Mini Winter B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OttawaMiniWinterB2025) 2025 (Saturday Morning). You will only be able to compete in one of these three competitions. Attempting to register for multiple of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

### Registration Reminders

If you are not a OCDSB student, you must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.


---

Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à une seule de ces trois compétitions. Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plusieurs de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée.

items.name: Chill Out Trondheim 2025
items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Chill Out Trondheim 2025! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 50kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025#51927-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors).


---

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Chill Out Trondheim 2025! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.

### On The Spot Registration
Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 50 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025#51927-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

Swisscubing Cup I fait partie de la Swisscubing Cup 2025, composé de 6 compétitions durant l'année. Jette un oeil sur notre [site web](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2024/) pour plus de détails sur les autres éditions. Le site web de la Swisscubingcup 2025 suivra.

Les compétiteurs qui s'inscrivent et ne viennent pas à la compétition devront payer les frais d'inscriptions à leur prochaine compétition en Suisse.

______________________________________________________________________________________________

Swisscubing Cup I ist Teil des Swisscubing Cup 2025. Dieser besteht aus 6 Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, besuche unsere [Website](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2024/). Die Website für den Swisscubingcup 2025 folgt. 

Teilnehmer die sich registrieren aber nicht bezahlen, müssen die Teilnahmegebühr bei ihrer nächsten Competition in der Schweiz bezahlen.
______________________________________________________________________________________________

Swisscubing Cup I is part of the Swisscubing Cup 2025, made of 6 competitions during the whole year. Check out our [website](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2024/) for the details of the other editions. The website for the Swisscubingcup 2025 will follow.

A competitor who registers and doesn't show up at the competition will have to pay that registration fee at his next competition in Switzerland.
